premises.text: Local governments struggle with decision-making due to data being trapped in silos.
premises.evidence_span: the data is trapped in silos

premises.text: Medium-sized cities spend significant resources on manual data processing.
premises.evidence_span: a medium-sized city spends more than 100,000 euros per year just on manual data processing

premises.text: Politea can produce reports and actionable insights from existing legacy systems.
premises.evidence_span: We take data from any existing legacy system and produce reports and actionable insights

premises.text: The Politea platform is modular and aligned with various city services.
premises.evidence_span: The Politea platform is modular and aligned with the city services

premises.text: City leaders can track performance and forecast demand using Politea.
premises.evidence_span: city leaders can track their performance, optimize their costs, and forecast the demand over the next years

premises.text: Politea can digitize data that exists only on paper.
premises.evidence_span: if the data exists only on paper, no problem, we digitize it as a service

premises.text: Politea's competition includes legacy systems and consultancies that do not meet local needs.
premises.evidence_span: legacy systems can provide all automatic integrations. Consultancies deliver static and expensive reports

premises.text: The GovTech market in Europe has high potential and is valued at 1.6 billion annually.
premises.evidence_span: The market value amounts up to 1.6 billion annually in Europe

premises.text: Politea uses a software-as-a-service business model with a setup fee and annual license fee.
premises.evidence_span: We run a software-as-a-service business model with a one-time setup fee and an annual license fee

value.text: City leaders can make data-driven decisions to improve the lives of citizens.
value.evidence_span: improving the life of millions of their citizens

notes: Customer count and lead generation are excluded as traction.
